paper.title: Adaptive Batch Sizes Using Non-Euclidean Gradient Noise Scales for Stochastic Sign and Spectral Descent

original_contract.precedence: The five source-pinned claims in the original contract are preserved.

claims.paper_claim: Non-Euclidean GNS reduces 160M Llama steps for Signum and Muon while matching the baseline loss.
claims.producer: Ten-seed 160M Llama/C4 training, constant and adaptive schedules, validation-loss baseline crossing, and median step reduction.
claims.local_evidence: Pinned source and feasibility audit only; no model, data, checkpoint, or run trace.

claims.paper_claim: The same 160M setup reports 22.58%, 67.13%, and 16.49% step reductions for signSGD, AdamW, and spectral descent.
claims.producer: Controlled optimizer-specific training and metric aggregation against constant-batch baselines.
claims.local_evidence: Paper table only; no independent optimizer runs.

claims.paper_claim: The Manhattan and Nuclear GNS metrics are squared ratios in the optimizer-matched dual norms.
claims.producer: Coordinate standard deviations or row covariance, dual-norm calculation, and squared noise-to-signal ratio.
claims.local_evidence: Finite four-vector/four-matrix toy with recorded outputs and a documented spectral proxy.

claims.paper_claim: The 1B Llama setup reports 31.84% and 12.11% reductions for signSGD and Signum while AdamW misses the baseline.
claims.producer: 1B/22B-token C4 training, adaptive schedule, validation-loss crossing, and step-count aggregation.
claims.local_evidence: Paper table only; no 1B model, data, checkpoint, or trace.

claims.paper_claim: Algorithm 1 provides a distributed, low-overhead variance estimator and adaptive batch-size procedure.
claims.producer: Per-rank local gradients, AllReduce or ReduceScatter/AllGather statistics, EMA, warm-up, monotonic batch updates, and square-root learning-rate scaling.
claims.local_evidence: Pinned equations and algorithm only; no DDP/FSDP implementation or execution.
